function.name: impl_from_IClassFactory
function.description: This function returns a pointer to a ClassFactoryImpl structure that contains the IClassFactory interface passed to it.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to an IClassFactory interface.

function.return_type: ClassFactoryImpl pointer, which represents the ClassFactoryImpl structure that contains the IClassFactory interface.

function.name: ClassFactoryImpl_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface ID matches either IID_IUnknown or IID_IClassFactory. If it does, it assigns the address of the IClassFactory interface to the provided pointer and increases the reference count. If it doesn't, it assigns NULL to the provided pointer and returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IClassFactory interface

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: Interface ID to be checked

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer that will receive the address of the requested interface

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the operation was successful, E_INVALIDARG if the ppv parameter is NULL, or E_NOINTERFACE if the requested interface is not supported

function.name: ClassFactoryImpl_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the ClassFactoryImpl object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to the IClassFactory interface object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the updated reference count of the ClassFactoryImpl object.

function.name: ClassFactoryImpl_Release
function.description: This function decrements the reference count of the class factory implementation. If the reference count reaches zero, the memory allocated for the class factory implementation is freed.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the interface of the class factory.

function.return_type: ULONG. This represents the updated reference count after decrementing.

function.name: ClassFactoryImpl_CreateInstance
function.description: This function creates an instance of a class factory implementation.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface of the class factory.

parameters.name: pUnkOuter
parameters.description: Pointer to the controlling IUnknown interface of the aggregate.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface that the caller is to use to communicate with the new object.

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the call to the function. It can be a success or an error code.

function.name: ClassFactoryImpl_LockServer
function.description: This function is a stub, currently not implemented, and is used to lock or unlock the class factory server.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the interface of the class factory.

parameters.name: lock
parameters.description: This parameter is a boolean value indicating whether to lock (TRUE) or unlock (FALSE) the server.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the result of the operation. In this case, it always returns E_NOTIMPL indicating that the function is not implemented.

function.name: ClassFactoryImpl_Constructor
function.description: This function is a constructor for the ClassFactoryImpl class. It allocates memory for a new ClassFactoryImpl object, sets its properties, and performs a query interface operation.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Pointer to the class information to be used in the constructor.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the interface identifier that will be used in the query interface operation.

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Pointer to the pointer variable that will receive the interface pointer from the query interface operation.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails, otherwise it returns the result of the query interface operation.

function.name: DllGetClassObject
function.description: This function retrieves a class object from a DLL object and provides a pointer to its IClassFactory interface, if it is available.

parameters.name: rclsid
parameters.description: This is the CLSID associated with the data and code that will be used to create the object.

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: This is the identifier of the interface that the caller is to use to communicate with the object.

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: This is the address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid. Upon successful return, *ppv contains the requested interface pointer. If the object does not support the interface specified in iid, the function sets ppv to NULL.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. Returns standard COM error codes as well as S_OK for successful retrieval of the class object.

function.name: create_instance
function.description: This function creates an instance of a class. It iterates through the 'wic_classes' array and checks if the 'classid' of any element matches the 'clsid' parameter. If a match is found, it calls the 'constructor' function of the matching element with 'iid' and 'ppv' as arguments. If no match is found, it calls the 'CoCreateInstance' function with 'clsid', 'NULL', 'CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER', 'iid', and 'ppv' as arguments.

parameters.name: clsid
parameters.description: Pointer to the class identifier of the object to be created

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface identifier that the object is being created for

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Pointer to the pointer that receives the interface pointer requested in 'iid'. Upon successful return, '*ppv' contains the requested interface pointer

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the function call. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code
